meta.household: Married filing jointly, two children (ages 8 and 5), all income from wages
meta.blended: owner and renter results weighted by ACS 2025 homeownership share
meta.sales_tax: IRS 2025 optional state and local sales tax tables plus an annualized vehicle-purchase tax
meta.progressivity_gap: 90th-percentile effective rate minus 10th-percentile effective rate, percentage points; positive = progressive; diverging scale centered on 0
meta.mortgage: One regime: 80% loan-to-value, 2025 average 30-year fixed rate; FHA footnotes where the effect is 0.1 point or more
meta.sources: See README.md and data/raw for every input and its source.
